notes: class_order is intentionally NOT stored here: it is loaded at runtime from class_mapping_path so a stale duplicate copy can never disagree with configs/class_mapping.json.
image_size 224 matches MobileNetV2's native input resolution.
batch_size 16 is small enough for CPU training; raise it if a GPU is available.
learning_rate 0.001 is the Adam default used for the frozen-base baseline.
baseline_max_epochs is the planned maximum for the baseline run; early stopping may end sooner.
